scenes.line1: How do you keep code clean?
scenes.say: How do you keep your Android code clean and testable, even as your app grows?
MVVM splits your app into three parts. The View handles the user interface. The ViewModel manages UI state and business logic. The Repository abstracts your data sources, like databases or APIs.

scenes.label: Hilt
scenes.say: Hilt is a dependency injection tool. It automatically provides things like repositories to your ViewModels, making your code less tangled and easier to test.
Here, Hilt injects a user repository into your ViewModel. No manual wiring needed—just clean, testable code.

scenes.question: What does ViewModel survive?
scenes.right: It survives configuration changes, like rotation, so you don't lose UI state.
scenes.say: Don't trip up in interviews: ViewModel survives configuration changes, not just activity restarts. That's how your UI state stays safe.
